Target Target Details
Reduce GHG emissions intensity rate 25%**
• Base year: 2019
• Target year: 2030
• U.S. and Trinidad operations
• Gross operated Scope 1 GHG emissions
Maintain near-zero methane emissions**
• Near-zero methane emissions is defined as a methane emissions percentage at or below 0.20%
• Target year: 2025–2030
• U.S. and Trinidad operations
• Gross operated Scope 1 methane emissions
Maintain zero routine flaring • Target year: 2025–2030
• U.S. and Trinidad operations

2030 GHG Emissions Intensity Rate Target
For the purposes of EOG's target, GHG emissions intensity is calculated as metric tons of Total Scope 1 GHG emissions, on a CO2e basis, per MBoe of U.S. and Trinidad Total Gross Operated Production.
Includes Scope 1 GHG emissions (1) reported to the EPA pursuant to the EPA Greenhouse Gas Reporting Program and emissions that are subject to the EPA Greenhouse Gas Reporting Program but are below the basin reporting threshold and would otherwise go unreported calculated using the Greenhouse Gas Reporting Program methodology as adopted in 2024 and (2) from our Trinidad operations calculated using the Greenhouse Gas Reporting Program methodology as adopted in 2024.

Our new GHG and methane emissions targets reflect the EPA's Greenhouse Gas Reporting Protocol (GHGRP) methodology updates adopted in 2024. The EPA's updated GHGRP emissions reporting requirements expand the types of emissions sources that must be reported, and also update calculation and emissions factors for some sources and equipment that have been previously reported. To inform our new GHG and methane emissions targets, we recalculated historical emissions based on the updated EPA GHGRP requirements and will calculate annual emissions target performance in alignment with the updated reporting requirements going forward.

note: criteria 1, 2, 3, 4 — 4 of 5. Criterion 1 (quantitative grounding) satisfied: three named targets each carry a specific quantitative threshold — GHG intensity reduction of 25%, methane emissions percentage at or below 0.20%, and zero routine flaring; all figures are stated with explicit units or thresholds per the handbook examples of percentage reduction and intensity targets. Criterion 2 (target-bound) satisfied: the GHG intensity target states base year 2019 and target year 2030 explicitly on p.34; this is sufficient to satisfy criterion 2 even if the methane and flaring targets carry target windows (2025–2030) without a separate named baseline year. Criterion 3 (methodology disclosed) satisfied: p.76 defines the exact intensity calculation formula (Total Scope 1 GHG emissions in metric tons CO2e per MBoe of Total Gross Operated Production), names the EPA GHGRP 2024 methodology as adopted as the calculation standard and boundary definition, and specifies that sub-threshold and Trinidad sources are both included; span 3 on p.34 further states that historical emissions were recalculated under the updated EPA GHGRP methodology, establishing a consistent calculation basis for the targets. Criterion 4 (time horizon) satisfied: target year 2030 and target window 2025–2030 are both explicitly stated on p.34. Criterion 5 (progress tracking) not satisfied: no current-period performance versus the 2019 baseline is disclosed for the new 2030 target; the report's Data Tear Sheet on p.6 covers 2020–2024 only and the 2019 baseline GHG intensity figure is never stated anywhere in the report; the 2025 Targets and Achievements box on p.21 reports progress against the prior 2025 targets (achieved in 2022, 2023, and 2024), not against the new 2030 target, so those progress statements belong to M6 for the prior target cycle and do not satisfy criterion 5 for the new 2030 target. Net zero ambition boundary note: EOG states a long-term net zero Scope 1 and Scope 2 ambition (p.21) with no fixed target date; per handbook pitfall, net-zero pledges without both baseline and target year are not coded as satisfying criterion 2 and this ambition is noted here but does not affect the criteria count. coverage_scope: corporate — all three targets apply to U.S. and Trinidad operations (gross operated), covering the full reporting boundary of the company as described. Cross-concept notes: span 1 target details also support O1 (methane target) and O2 (zero routine flaring target); span 3 methodology statement on EPA GHGRP 2024 updates also informs F1.
